scripts.test: cargo test && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" && node --test tests/functions/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && node scripts/check-state-architecture.mjs && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:rust:deep: npm run lint:rust:miri && npm run lint:rust:fuzz && npm run lint:rust:mutants
scripts.lint:web: npm run lint:web:eslint && npm run lint:web:biome
scripts.lint:quality: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:rust && node scripts/check-state-architecture.mjs && npm run lint:rust:deep
scripts.cfp:weekly: npm run cfp:update && npm run cfp:validate && npm run build
